10671.commentary: (VINa) avilutte'ti ettha pana gabbhaṃ bhinditvā pasayhāvahāravasena avilutte'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: adaḍḍhe daḍḍhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avilutte viluttasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

10672.meaning2: not disagreeing with; not disputing with

10673.meaning2: not dispersed; not diffused; not spread out; not wide-spread
10673.commentary: (MNa) avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti nikantivasena ārammaṇe tiṭṭhamānaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭaṃ nāma hoti, taṃ paṭisedhento evam'āha. (ITIa) bahiddhā c'assa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti bahiddhā rūp'ādiārammaṇe uppajjanakavikkhep'ābhāvato avikkhittaṃ samāhitaṃ, tato eva avisaṭaṃ siyā.

examples.text: tathā tathā, bhikkhave, bhikkhu upaparikkheyya yathā yathā upaparikkhato bahiddhā c'assa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭaṃ, ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitaṃ anupādāya na paritasseyya.
tatra, bhikkhave, taramānassa bhāsato kāyo'pi kilamati, cittam'pi upahaññati, saro'pi upahaññati, kaṇṭho'pi āturīyati, avisaṭṭham'pi hoti aviññeyyaṃ taramānassa bhāsitaṃ.

10675.meaning1: outside of one's element; out of one's domain; not within one's range

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭhā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na c'eva sampāyissanti, uttariñ'ca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti. taṃ kissa hetu? yathā taṃ, bhikkhave, avisayasmiṃ.
sac'assa hoti avisayhaṃ, hatthavikārena dutiyaṃ āmantetvā hatthavilaṅghakena upaṭṭhāpema, na tv'eva mayaṃ, bhante, tappaccayā vācaṃ bhindāma

10678.grammar: prp of na visahati, neg, intrans (+inf)
10678.meaning1: not being able (to); not being capable (of)

examples.text: cha corā na laddho vat'āsi amhehi, ajja te vividhāni kammakāraṇāni kāretvā bahudhanaṃ āharāpessāmā'ti cintetvā, udak'aṇṇavaṃ otarituṃ asakkontā rañño āṇāya kopitattā parato gantum'pi avisahantā tatth'eva sussitvā mareyyuṃ.

10679.grammar: prp of na visahati, neg, intrans (+inf)
10679.meaning1: not daring; not having the courage (to)

examples.text: yo imaṃ lekhaṃ antaraṃ karoti, rāj'āṇāya kāretabbo'ti. mahājanakajātake bodhisattena katalekhaṃ sīvalidevī antaraṃ kātuṃ avisahantī vivattamānā agamāsi.

10681.grammar: adj, from na visaṃvāda, neg x2, caus (+dat)
10681.meaning1: not breaking one's word; keeping promises (with); not deceiving
10681.constructionSummary: na + vi + saṃ + vāde + a + ka
10681.construction:
na > a + vi + saṃ + vāde + a + ka
avisaṃvāda + ka

examples.text: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato ahosiṃ saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.

10682.grammar: fem, abstr, from na visaṃvādanā, neg, caus
10682.meaning1: honesty; not breaking one's word; keeping promises
10682.constructionSummary: na + vi + saṃ + vāde + anā + tā
10682.construction:
na > a + vi + saṃ + vāde + anā + tā
avisaṃvādanā + tā
10682.commentary: (DNa) avisaṃvādanatāyā'ti yassa yassa nāmaṃ gaṇhāti, taṃ taṃ avisaṃvādetvā idam'pi amhākaṃ gehe atthi, idam'pi atthi, gahetvā gacchāhī'ti evaṃ avisaṃvādetvā dānena. (DNt) cattāri'pi ṭhānāni laṅghitvā pañcamam'eva ṭhānaṃ vivarituṃ avisaṃvādanatāyā'ti-ādi vuttaṃ. tattha yassa yassa nāmaṃ gaṇhātī'ti sahāyo atthikabhāvena yassa yassa vatthuno nāmaṃ katheti.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi kulaputtena uttarā disā mitt'āmaccā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, dānena peyyavajjena atthacariyāya samān'attatāya avisaṃvādanatāya.

10683.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from na visaṃvādeti, neg x2, caus
10683.meaning1: not breaking one's word; keeping promises; not being deceptive
10683.construction: na > a + vi + saṃ + vāde + anā

examples.text: kalyāṇamittatā sīlānaṃ āhāro, indriyasaṃvaro brahmacariyassa āhāro, avisaṃvādanā mittānaṃ āhāro

10684.grammar: adj, from na visaṃvāda, neg x2, caus
10684.meaning1: not breaking one's word; not lying; not deceiving
10684.constructionSummary: na + vi + saṃ + vāde + a + ika
10684.construction:
na > a + vi + saṃ + vāde + a + ika
avisaṃvāda + ika

10685.construction: na > a + vi + saṃ + vāde + anā

10686.commentary: (DNa) avisārado'ti gahaṭṭho tāva, avassaṃ bahūnaṃ sannipātaṭṭhāne keci mama kammaṃ jānissanti, atha maṃ niggaṇhissantī'ti vā, rājakulassa vā dassantī'ti sabhayo upasaṅkamati, maṅkubhūto pattakkhandho adhomukho aṅgulikena bhūmiṃ kasanto nisīdati, visārado hutvā kathetuṃ na sakkoti. pabbajito'pi, bahū bhikkhū sannipatitā, avassaṃ koci mama kammaṃ jānissati, atha me uposatham'pi pavāraṇam'pi ṭhapetvā sāmaññato cāvetvā nikkaḍḍhissantī'ti sabhayo upasaṅkamati, visārado hutvā kathetuṃ na sakkoti. ekacco pana dussīlo'pi dappito viya vicarati, so'pi ajjh'āsayena maṅku hoti'y'eva.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, dussīlo sīlavipanno yaññad'eva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, avisārado upasaṅkamati maṅkubhūto. ayaṃ tatiyo ādīnavo dussīlassa sīlavipattiyā.
aṭṭh'aṅgasamannāgato kho pan'assa bhoto gotamassa mukhato ghoso niccharati, vissaṭṭho ca, viññeyyo ca, mañju ca, savanīyo ca, bindu ca, avisārī ca, gambhīro ca, ninnādī ca.

10689.grammar: nt, abstr, from na visiṭṭha, neg
10689.meaning1: fact of not being distinguished; fact of not being excellent; fact of being ordinary
10689.construction:
na > a + vi + √sis + ta + tta
avisiṭṭha + tta

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sāḷha, bhabbo nu kho so puriso nadiṃ taritun'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante. taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bhante, sālalaṭṭhi bahiddhā suparikammakatā anto avisuddhā. tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi saṃsīdissati, puriso anayabyasanaṃ āpajjissatī'ti.

10691.meaning2: with no difference (to); similar (to); same (as); alike

10692.commentary: (VINa) avissajjite vissajjitasaññī'ti kassaci adinne apariccatte pariccattaṃ mayā'ti evaṃsaññī.

examples.text: avikappite vikappitasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. avissajjite vissajjitasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. anaṭṭhe naṭṭhasaññī, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

10693.grammar: abs of na vissajjeti, neg, caus, trans (+acc)
10693.meaning1: having not got rid (of); having not given up
10693.construction:
na > a + vi + sajje + tvā
na + vissajjetvā

examples.text: orena ce channaṃ vassānaṃ taṃ santhataṃ vissajjetvā vā avissajjetvā vā aññaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya aññatra bhikkhusammutiyā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

10694.grammar: prp of na vissasati, neg, intrans (+gen)
10694.commentary: (VINa) tassa vā avissasanto'ti yena vinayakammaṃ kataṃ, tassa avissāsena vā.

examples.text: appaccuddhāraṇaṃ nāma tassa vā adinnaṃ, tassa vā avissasanto paribhuñjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.

10695.meaning1: unbelievable; not trustworthy; not credible; not reliable

examples.text: tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ'c'eva vivaranti, anuttānīkatañ'ca uttānī karonti, anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.

10697.meaning1: not arguing; not disputing; not quarrelling

10699.grammar: prp of na vivadati, neg, intrans
10699.commentary: (VINa) avivadamāno'ti, ayaṃ dhammo, n'āyaṃ dhammo'ti evaṃ na vivadamāno

examples.text: samet'āyasmā saṅghena, samaggo hi saṅgho sammodamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeso phāsu viharatī'ti
kacci pana vo, anuruddhā, samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīr'odakībhūtā aññam'aññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharathā'ti?
